mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_vocabulary (user_id, normalized_form, word_id, display_form, translation, mark_count, first_marked_at, last_marked_at, mastery, review_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{normalizedForm}, #{wordId}, #{displayForm}, #{translation}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mark_count = user_vocabulary.mark_count + 1, last_marked_at = NOW(), word_id = COALESCE(new.word_id, user_vocabulary.word_id), display_form = COALESCE(new.display_form, user_vocabulary.display_form), translation = COALESCE(new.translation, user_vocabulary.translation)
